method: Source-derived comparison relation metadata. Operand roots recovered from located AST preorder and containment. Arity check is structural, not proof of operand evaluation equivalence; compound operands retain their original node and range instead of copied expression source. Native chained comparisons evaluate each middle operand once and short-circuit. Identity, membership, strict and inclusive operators stay distinct. Literal tokens are prior source lexeme metadata, not decoded or rounded values.
